status: Full local export complete; listening review of the full cut remains with owner

pronunciation.cfo.ai: C F O dot A I

sentences: When a report job stops, its completed work may still be saved. The next step depends on the evidence.
Meet Nightshift. An AI agent for stalled report jobs. Investigate. Repair. Verify.
In this controlled Sonnet run, the job was stalled.
The worker lease had expired, and parsing was saved.
Nightshift inspected the job, worker, checkpoint, and errors before acting.
The model selects the tools.
Code enforces scope, leases, generations, and request limits.
The expired lease was reclaimed into generation two.
Nightshift resumed from the saved checkpoint.
The action was applied, and the report moved into verification.
Report totals: five rows, one hundred and twenty minutes.
Input reconciled. No mismatches.
Upload non-sensitive data. Download the report.
This separate healthy check verified four rows and forty-four minutes, using two model calls.
Active workers stay protected.
In the labelled safety lab, a deterministic checker escalated the active lease.
No reclaim, and no model calls.
neatlogs exposed an earlier sequencing defect.
Reclaim succeeded, but resume was not offered next.
With the tool catalog corrected, a later run resumed and verified its report.
Entire connects coding context to repository checkpoints and commits.
These build checkpoints are separate from Nightshift’s runtime recovery checkpoints.
cfo.ai helped model recovery pricing and operating costs.
We also tested a higher-price scenario.
These are assumptions. No actual customers or revenue.
For small teams running their own report pipelines.
Pick up where work stopped.
Explore Nightshift in our public repository.
